title: Eagle Lake sphere answers SOS and chases canoe
place_text: Eagle Lake near Smith Brook campsite, Allagash Waterway, Maine

tellings.link_reason: The same Eagle Lake moment as telling 1, with the sphere closing in on the canoe, told now by Jim Weiner, whose memory breaks off at that point.

as_told.title: Memory gap as sphere closes in behind the canoe

plain: In 1976, on Eagle Lake in Maine's Allagash Waterway, four men camping near Smith Brook saw a light they first took for the moon, a white circle the size of an aspirin, until it started to move; it is said to have answered their SOS signal and chased their canoe. Charlie Foltz, one of the four, describes the light, and Jim Weiner, another, says the sphere was right behind them and he remembers nothing more until the canoe reached the campsite shore. The other two were Jack Weiner and Chuck Rak, and the missing time is why the story is told as an alien abduction.
